title: NativQA: Multilingual Culturally-Aligned Natural Query for LLMs
reasoning: The paper presents the MultiNativQA benchmark dataset, which explicitly includes 'Religion' as one of its 18 core topics. Topic-wise distribution charts (Figures 7-10) show that religious queries constitute a significant portion of the data for several languages (e.g., over 10% for English-BD), and the paper evaluates how LLMs handle these culturally and religiously nuanced queries.
